14 teams participated in the '''1991–92 Egyptian Premier League season'''. The first team in the league was the champion, and qualified to the [[1993 African Cup of Champions Clubs|African Cup of Champions Clubs]].
[[Zamalek SC|Zamalek]] won the league for the 7th time in the club's history.<ref>[[:ar:الدوري المصري الممتاز 1991–92]]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9192.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210131195409/http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9192.html|url-status=usurped|archive-date=January 31, 2021|title=Egyptian Soccer League 1991/92|website=drtareksaid.net}}</ref>
